column1: # Pinned real-world corpus. Columns are tab-separated:
# name <TAB> clone URL <TAB> commit <TAB> subdirectory <TAB> markers
# Commits are full SHAs on purpose: a nightly run must test the same code even
# when upstream default branches move. Update deliberately when reviewing
# scanner changes, and record the new date in docs/validation.md.
# markers: "-" means no custom markers; otherwise pass --markers so apps whose
# request contracts live in an external package or are repeated per module are
# measured with their intended abstractions. Results still record the markers
# used, so a default-scan gap remains visible in the notes.
